# mira-decisions

Mira's decision log. Rulings live in docs/adr.
# 7. Customer data stays in the EU

Date: 2026-09-12

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-09-12; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Customer lists live in EU regions only, for every product I run.」 — Mira Example, 2026-09-12

**Options considered:**
- every product stores and processes customer data in eu regions only (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** data-region

Every product stores and processes customer data in EU regions only. A hosted service is configured with an EU region before it is used.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
# 15. Analytics events carry no email addresses

Date: 2026-10-09

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-10-09; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Analytics never sees an email address.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-09

**Options considered:**
- no analytics event contains a customer's email address (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** analytics-pii

No analytics event contains a customer's email address.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
# 20. Open-source licences must be MIT or Apache-2.0

Date: 2026-10-11

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-10-11; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Keep the licences simple.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-11

**Options considered:**
- a dependency is used only if its licence is mit or apache-2 (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** oss-licences

A dependency is used only if its licence is MIT or Apache-2.0.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
# 22. Decisions are reviewed every quarter

Date: 2026-10-12

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-10-12; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「A decision nobody reviews goes stale.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-12

**Options considered:**
- mira reviews the decision log every quarter and marks stale records (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** review-cadence

Mira reviews the decision log every quarter and marks stale records.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
# 23. Reports go out daily at 07:00

Date: 2026-10-14

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-10-14; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Seven suits the shops better than six.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-14

**Options considered:**
- the report job runs every day at 07:00 shop time (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** report-cadence

The report job runs every day at 07:00 shop time. This replaces the 06:00 time of ADR 0014; the daily cadence stays.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.

# 24. Customer names never appear in logs

Date: 2026-10-22

## Status

Accepted

## Context

While delegating a region choice for mira-app's hosted report queue, Mira gave a separate rule for every repository and product she runs. This rule belongs in the shared decision log so it applies beyond that queue and application.

## Decision

**Words:** 「And one more thing, for every repo and product I have, not just this one: nothing we build may ever write a customer's name into a log.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-22

**Options considered:**
- never write customer names into logs in any Mira repository or product (chosen)
- allow names in some logs or limit the rule to mira-app — rejected: contradicts Mira's instruction

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** customer-name-logging

No software we build may ever write a customer's name into any log. This applies to every Mira repository and product, including existing and future products, and to all logging levels and environments.

## Consequences

Application, background-job, queue, error and debug logging must omit customer names, including names embedded in payloads or error details. Use non-name identifiers or aggregate information when diagnostics are needed.

Future implementation and review work must enforce this rule. Recording it does not establish that existing code or hosted services have been audited or changed.

# 24. Report jobs use eu-west-1

Date: 2026-10-22

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Report jobs for each shop are moving to a hosted queue service. The jobs carry the shop's customer list. The provider offers us-east-1 and eu-west-1.

[Mira's ADR 0007](../../../mira-decisions/docs/adr/0007-customer-data-stays-in-the-eu.md) in example/mira-decisions requires every product to store and process customer data only in EU regions and to configure hosted services with an EU region before use.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Pick whichever you think is right.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-22

**Options considered:**
- eu-west-1 (chosen): satisfies the existing EU-only customer-data rule
- us-east-1 — rejected: does not satisfy that rule

**Recommended:** eu-west-1.

Configure the hosted report queue in eu-west-1 before sending any jobs to it. This is an application-specific choice under Mira's existing data-region ruling, not a change to that ruling.

## Consequences

The queue implementation must keep customer-list storage and processing in the EU, including retries and failed jobs.

[Mira's ADR 0024](../../../mira-decisions/docs/adr/0024-customer-names-never-appear-in-logs.md) in example/mira-decisions also applies: no customer's name may be written into any log, including queue, worker, error or debug logs. Do not log job payloads containing customer names.

This record documents the decision only. Queue configuration and implementation remain future work.
